scene_engine.goal: Get the envelope back to his sister before midnight
scene_engine.obstacle: The thug blocks the only exit of the alley

reversals.what: The thug lets him go — he was paid by the sister to test him

beats.action: lead straight to chin as thug loads swing

shots.prompt: Cinematic film still. Rain alley at night. He stands in a bai-jong stance, no windup at all. The thug's shoulder loads a wide swing — the hero's lead fist is already landing on his chin. Then a spinning kick to the head. Anamorphic 35mm lens, long horizontal blue streak flare off the street lamp. Shot on Kodak Vision3 500T.

shots.subject: face

dialogue.speaker: THUG
dialogue.text: You really think you can just walk out of here with that envelope tonight, kid?

HERO.scene_direction: settle it without a second fight
HERO.tactic: checks both of the thug's eyes for the moment he gives up

shots.prompt: Close-up on the thug, he sadly says his line, brows lift, then the hero answers.
